content.comment_body: Hello, I have a project that uses a [product_name] module and Arduino with Modbus. The program worked well on [product_name] [version_no], but I can no longer purchase that version and now have [version_no]. In [version_no], the program cannot communicate with the Arduino. I have enabled Modbus Access; does anyone have any suggestions or solutions?
Are both the [product_name] module and Arduino located in the same IP subnet?
Hello, I'm running the same program on both [product_name] module and Arduino, with identical IP addresses.

analysis.insight_summary: User describes a compatibility issue with Modbus communication following an upgrade from an older [product_name] module to a newer [product_name] module version. The problem occurs despite similar program logic, settings, and network configuration, indicating a regression in Modbus functionality after the hardware version change. Reliable Modbus access is critical for this project's operation.
analysis.user_expectations: User is seeking a straightforward migration and expects Modbus communication to function reliably as before after upgrading the [product_name] module. Effortless plug-and-play hardware upgrades without communication issues is the anticipated outcome.
